headline: Good angle and size today, but onshore all day makes it a mush-fest.
today: There's 1.5-2ft in the water at a good SE angle, but the SSE onshore blows 12-13mph through the whole daylight window, so it'll be bumpy and disorganized. Not worth the 2.5-hour drive. Sit tight — tomorrow is the reason to come out here.

daysToWatch.note: This is the day to make the drive. Prime SSE angle, 2-2.6ft, and near-glassy dawn and morning (2-3mph). Get there early, shortboard or fish; the S onshore is light but creeps in by afternoon.
Backup day — N offshore dawn to morning cleans up a 1.9-2.1ft prime swell. Clean and fun early before the SSW cross-on evening. Worth it if you can't make Friday.
Warning: swell drops under 1.7ft and SW wind ramps to 21mph by evening. Blown out, skip it.
